Resolved s1 frontier item 1: $t9 IS reachable by genuine register pressure (N>=22 live scratch pseudos, no REG_ALLOC_ORDER override for MIPS), but only at the cost of a 110-insn body with $s0-$s7 save

frontier.hypothesis: A frame-free C chassis puts the 0x1F800400 address in $t9 (the remaining operand-only hunk).
frontier.mechanism: global.c's ascending order puts $s0-$s7 before $t8/$t9; s2 (global) and s5 (block-local) pressure both added frames or spills.
frontier.next_probe: Hand-write a chassis where only call-clobbered values (a0-a3 params, v0/v1) are live across the store, measured with dump.ps1 .greg; caller evidence (void(void) sink) argues against it, so treat it as the last C axis.

frontier.hypothesis: A scan_hand_coded signal for a module-relative pad word after the final jr's delay slot would give func_80052C10 a gate-class STRONG tier of its own.
frontier.mechanism: the 11-function jr;nop;nop census: the other 10 are Sony asmpsx modules, and the module-relative pad fits a module 0x80052788..0x80052C28.
frontier.next_probe: Operator/owner work outside the Grinder surface (tools/scan_hand_coded.py; a new signal class needs owner approval per the ruling).

frontier.hypothesis: The hand-asm module containing func_80052C10 starts at math_LerpSVector 0x80052788 (the alternative start is 0x80052A88).
frontier.mechanism: module-relative 16-pad: both starts are 8 mod 16; LerpSVector and LerpMatrix3x3 are STRONG S9, the gte_* functions between are LOW.
frontier.next_probe: Check whether gte_SumSquares3 (0x80052754, ends at 0x80052788) closes a compiled or asm object (pad or trap signatures), to pin the boundary as evidence under rodata-object-alignment.md New TU boundaries.

judge_constraints: No canonical-asm keep or grant for func_80052C10 without a gate-class STRONG scan_hand_coded hit (adding a new signal class needs owner approval, so it is not a grind lever). Next C shape: test the trailing nop as a TU boundary, with func_80052C10 ending its own object at 0x80052C24 and the 8-aligned next object starting at 0x80052C28. Measure it in a scratch build. Landing it needs bb2.ld/TU-split surface, so file an integration-handoff with the measurements. Separately, keep hunting the $t9 seat with a structurally different, frame-free chassis. Otherwise the function stays INCLUDE_ASM in the worklist.
